summary: Feature gap identified: move money tool lacks Income as destination
detailed_context: Nick is identifying a critical limitation in the move money tool that was just shipped. He needs to move excess from 'adhoc' to 'rental' because he won't receive income this month, but the move money tool doesn't include 'Income' as a destination category. This is a clear miss—the previous response celebrated the v1.22.0 release without addressing this actual use-case requirement. Nick had to circle back and explicitly point out the gap after the feature shipped. This signals the feature doesn't fully meet his needs.
